title: permissionProfileLocation
responsibility: Links a permission profile in the shown branch and revision.

inputs.name: permissionProfileLocation.route
inputs.description: Shown branch and revision; all other route fields are omitted.

inputs.name: permissionProfileLocation.entity
inputs.description: Optional declared profile ID. Omitted or empty selects the profile index.

outputs.name: permissionProfileLocation
outputs.description: A Pages permission route scoped to the same branch and commit, with a truthy profile ID when provided.

errors.name: Input access failure
errors.description: Errors from supplied getters, collection methods or species constructors propagate unchanged.
